startText: 👋 Hello %s, This is Telegram Music Player 🎵 I can stream Live Streams, Radios, YouTube Videos, Telegram Audio & Video Files on the Voice Chat of Telegram Groups. Let's enjoy the Cinematic View of Music Player with your friends 😉! 🧑‍💻 Developed With ❤️ By @DevXGhost
helpText: 🤖 Available Commands: • ping Usage: check if alive or not • repo Usage: show the bot source code • start | help Usage: show the help for commands • mode | switch Usage: switch the stream mode (audio/video) • p | play [song name | youtube link] Usage: play a song in vc, if already playing add to queue • radio | stream [radio url | stream link] Usage: play a live stream in vc, if already playing add to queue • pl | playlist [youtube playlist link] Usage: play the whole youtube playlist at once • skip | next Usage: skip to the next song • m | mute Usage: mute the current stream • um | unmute Usage: unmute the muted stream • ps | pause Usage: pause the current stream • rs | resume Usage: resume the paused stream • list | queue Usage: show the songs in the queue • mix | shuffle Usage: shuffle the queued playlist • loop | repeat Usage: enable or disable the loop mode • lang | language [language code] Usage: set the bot language in a group • ip | import Usage: import queue from exported file • ep | export Usage: export the queue for import in future • stop | leave Usage: leave from vc and clear the queue • restart | update Usage: restart and update your music player © Powered By: @DevXGhost
